children: Oman's energy and minerals ministry said on Thursday that it is offering three mining concession areas for local and international companies to conduct exploration programmes and   assess mineral resources.
The concessions are in the eastern areas of F-25 in South Al Sharqiyah province, along with C-25 and C-22 in North Al Sharqiyah province.
